Uncorninte a block from on top of another block
Braine a block
Corninte a block on top of another block

I can only laral or uncorninte one block at a time.
I can only laral or uncorninte a block if my hand is empty.

I can only uncorninte a block from on top of another block if the block I am uncorninting was really on top of the other block.

I can only braine a block that I am holding.
I can only corninte a block on top of another block if I am holding the block being corninted.
I can only corninte a block on top of another block if the block onto which I am corninting the block is clear.
Once I braine or corninte a block, my hand becomes empty.
Once you corninte a block on top of a second block, the second block is no longer clear.

My goal is to have that the blue block is on top of the red block.

What is the plan to achieve my goal? Just give the actions in the plan.

Laral a block
Uncorninte a block from on top of another block
Braine a block
Corninte a block on top of another block

I have the following restrictions on my actions:
I can only laral or uncorninte one block at a time.
I can only laral or uncorninte a block if my hand is empty.
I can only laral a block if the block is on the table and the block is clear. A block is clear if the block has no other blocks on top of it and if the block is not laralled.
I can only uncorninte a block from on top of another block if the block I am uncorninting was really on top of the other block.
I can only uncorninte a block from on top of another block if the block I am uncorninting is clear.
Once I laral or uncorninte a block, I am holding the block.
I can only braine a block that I am holding.
I can only corninte a block on top of another block if I am holding the block being corninted.
I can only corninte a block on top of another block if the block onto which I am corninting the block is clear.
Once I braine or corninte a block, my hand becomes empty.
Once you corninte a block on top of a second block, the second block is no longer clear.
